messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two adult friends after one has made an important decision without telling the other. Let the other character notice small clues and understand that something has changed. Keep the information indirect and avoid explaining the hidden emotion or relationship dynamics.

“You're up early.”

Morgan looked up from the kitchen counter.

“Couldn't sleep.”

Casey nodded toward the coffee maker. “You started without me.”

“Sorry.”

“You never start without me.”

Morgan opened the cabinet and took down another mug.

“I figured you'd be awake soon.”

Casey watched her pour coffee.

“What's in the folder?”

Morgan glanced at the table.

“Nothing.”

Casey smiled faintly. “You don't carry nothing in a folder.”

Morgan slid the second mug across the counter.

“Cream?”

“Please.”

Morgan added it without asking how much.

Casey took the mug but didn't drink.

“You okay?”

“Yeah.”

“That was fast.”

Morgan looked down at her coffee.

Casey picked up the folder.

Morgan's hand moved toward it, then stopped.

Casey didn't open it.

She set it back down.

“Okay.”

“Okay.”

Casey took a sip.

The coffee was exactly how she liked it.

After a moment, she said, “You're going to tell me eventually.”

Morgan looked at her.

“Yeah.”

Casey nodded.

She didn't ask again.

Morgan reached across the counter and pulled the folder closer.

The coffee maker clicked as it finished brewing.

Neither of them said anything about it.
